thread:
sam: Quick catch during a docs QA pass: /rerank response examples still show "scores": [0.12, 0.03] (flat floats). The new server returns an array of objects: [{ "score": 0.12, "norm_score": 0.98, "id": "r1" }, ...]. We need to update the API ref and the python/curl snippets that parse scores.

aisha: Ugh, that explains some user confusion in support. Which files are autogenerated vs hand-written?

sam: The responses come from examples generator for rerank. The python snippet is hand-edited in docs/reference/rerank.md and the curl block is generated from examples/curl/rerank.json.

docbot: Note: open issue #942 added to track schema change in openapi -> examples.

kevin: I'll take the examples generator. Plan: change the examples template to emit objects for scores and sweep existing example assets. I will also grep for any code samples that assume scores is an array of floats.

marie: I'll update the python snippet in rerank.md because it parses scores with list comprehension: `scores = [s for s in resp["scores"]]` which will break. Should change to `scores = [s["score"] for s in resp["scores"]]` and add a comment about norm_score.

kevin: One more snag: curl examples currently inline the JSON body with single-line escaped strings which makes the example hard to read. I want to convert those to here-doc style (cat <<'JSON' | curl -X POST ...). Will do in the same PR.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 - updates rerank example assets, adjusts templates to emit score objects, and adds a test that validates example shapes against the latest schema.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/preview/1301. FYI the live preview highlights one more issue: the JS SDK sample still uses the old argument name `queries` instead of `items` per the new client API.

aisha: Good catch. The JS samples are pulled from sdk-snippets repo; last sync missed this endpoint. I can push a tiny change in sdk-snippets to rename `queries` -> `items`.

kevin: I updated the docs tests to assert the presence of `norm_score` in at least one example and to ensure scores is an array of objects. Also added a small parser test that loads the generated curl snippet and checks JSON shape.

marie: Patch for the python snippet pushed in the PR. Also added a short migration note in rerank.md: "If you vendor examples or parse scores, update your code to handle score objects: score and norm_score fields."

ci-bot: CI: examples-lint failed initially (some old example assets still referenced). Pushed a follow-up commit to remove deprecated examples. Re-run.

ci-bot: All checks passed \u2705. Preview looks good; rerank examples show object-shaped scores, python snippet updated, curl uses heredoc.

sam: Thanks! Merged to main and backported to release/v1.4. Filed follow-up to add a docs lint rule that runs a schema check against each example asset on CI.

kevin: Leaving the PR closed. If anyone finds a stray float-only example, ping me and I'll sweep.
